translation: A water blister is not a disease, but from few to many it is truly sufficient to cause disease. Just as when a great river rises, the foam at the bank gathers into great masses, all being accumulations of small water blisters. Why does the human body have this? Let me use an analogy. Just as leftover food and dishes at home, once heated, turn sour and produce bubbles, and if delayed further, white foam surges up; all of this is caused by accumulated heat.
